const numbers = new Set([1, 2]);
const union = numbers.union(new Set([3]));
const first: number = union.values().next().value!;
console.log(union, first);

function choose<T>(value: { has(item: T): boolean; values(): Iterator<T> }): T {
  return value.values().next().value;
}
const chosen: number = choose(new Set([4, 5]));
console.log(chosen);
